translations.web: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
translations.bsb: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
translations.kjv: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
